scripts.copy:static: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp src/manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp src/devtools_page.html dist/devtools_page.html && cp src/assets/devtools_page_icon.ico dist/assets/devtools_page_icon.ico && cp src/assets/devtools_page_icon-28px.ico dist/assets/devtools_page_icon-28px.ico
scripts.build: yarn ts-check && rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail 'yarn build:lib' 'yarn build:vite'
scripts.build:dev: rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail 'yarn build:lib:dev' 'yarn build:vite:dev'
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && yarn copy:static && concurrently --kill-others --names 'LIB,VITE' 'webpack --config webpack.config.cjs --mode development' 'vite build --mode development --watch'
scripts.zip: yarn build && cd dist && zip -r ../react-hooks-global-states-dev-tools.zip . && cd ..
